requirements.reason: The accepted authorization matrix must remain the source of truth for the 40 admin/high-risk route families and 187 D-owned route keys.
Every D-owned route must require the current verified active admin user before admin data or privileged behavior is reachable.
Every D-owned route currently marked as recent-admin protected must reject stale admin authentication before high-risk behavior can run.
Admin list, search, lookup, aggregate, and read routes must remain active-admin-only and preserve current source filtering, object binding, response, and concealment boundaries.
Admin user, account, and role actions must preserve active-admin gating, recent-authentication where current source requires it, final-admin/self protections, and rejected-side-effect boundaries.

Admin game, community-game, roster, venue, image, chat-moderation, and Need-a-Sub routes must preserve privileged object/list scope, action-state checks, recent-authentication where source requires it, and rejected-side-effect boundaries.

Admin money, credit, payment, refund, host-fee, payment-event, and financial-outcome routes must preserve active-admin gating, recent-authentication on high-risk repair or ledger actions, object/list scope, and rejected financial side effects.

Admin notification, platform-notice, policy, support-flag, review-case, rejected-attempt, chat-moderation, and admin-action surfaces must preserve admin-only access, current source state checks, and rejected notice/review/moderation side effects.

Field and mass-assignment proof must cover D-owned write surfaces where caller input could affect identity, role, account state, admin actor, game or venue state, financial/provider identity, notification recipient, moderation state, audit/action state, or other server-controlled fields.

Negative/default-deny proof must cover required 401, 403, 404, 410, ordinary-user denial, stale-role denial, stale recent-auth denial, cross-object denial, and rejected mutations with named no-side-effect assertions.

Requirement declarations, pytest markers, matrix checks, test names, and the testing record must remain traceable to the frozen D plan, approved intake, accepted A/B/C artifacts, current source, and accepted predecessor repository evidence.

Final WS03-04 parent-gap disposition must account for all A/B/C/D-owned obligations and record every remaining provider/runtime, audit-governance, named-permission, dual-control, export/unmask/read-audit, or minimum-necessary admin-data boundary with an explicit downstream owner or blocker.
